title: Tropical Storm Trudy Update, Mon, Oct 19: 60 mph Winds #shorts
description:
Tropical Storm Trudy: the latest from the National Hurricane Center (advisory 025, Mon, Oct 19, 8:00 AM PDT).

Maximum sustained winds 60 mph, minimum pressure 999 mb. Located at 19.5°N 108.5°W, moving WSW at 7 mph.

Forecast: Mon 5 PM: Tropical storm, 45 mph · Tue 5 AM: Tropical storm, 40 mph · Tue 5 PM: Tropical depression, 35 mph · Wed 5 AM: Tropical depression, 30 mph

Full advisory: https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/text/MIATCPEP1.shtml

Get severe weather alerts for your location, free: https://www.stormcentralwx.com

Storm Central is not an official warning system. Always follow the National Weather Service and your local emergency management. For official hurricane forecasts, see nhc.noaa.gov.

es.title: Tormenta tropical Trudy, actualización lun 19 de oct: vientos de 95 km/h #shorts
es.description:
Tormenta tropical Trudy: lo último del Centro Nacional de Huracanes (aviso 025, lun 19 de oct, 8:00 a.m. GMT-7).

Vientos máximos sostenidos de 95 km/h (60 mph), presión mínima de 999 mb. Ubicado en 19.5°N 108.5°W; se mueve hacia el OSO a 11 km/h.

Pronóstico: lun 5 p.m.: Tormenta tropical, 75 km/h · mar 5 a.m.: Tormenta tropical, 65 km/h · mar 5 p.m.: Depresión tropical, 55 km/h · mié 5 a.m.: Depresión tropical, 45 km/h
